merchants.name: Fresh Bamboo Kitchen / FRES
verified: Stripe onboarding is complete, the account is enabled, tax ID is provided, a company document was supplied and the payout bank is verified.
The submitted food-related MCC is coherent with the Fresh Bamboo Kitchen trading name.
unverified: Independent operating history, customer footprint, food-service licensing and a durable restaurant/business presence were not established.
contradictions: The submitted Fresh Bamboo Kitchen domain appears to have been newly registered on 1 October 2026, only days before enablement.

The submitted Mesa address is also the principal address of an established active Arizona entity, Relaxcation LLC, managed by the same representative but registered for real-estate/rental activity; the relationship between that entity, FRES and Fresh Bamboo Kitchen is not independently established.
evidenceNeeded: Verify Arizona registration/DBA tying FRES to Fresh Bamboo Kitchen, applicable food-service/health permit, payout-bank ownership, supplier receipts and historical customer/order records.
merchants.summary: Complete Stripe onboarding but materially weak external corroboration, a very new domain and an unresolved legal/entity/address relationship warrant enhanced diligence before additional payout exposure.
